name: Ko Kanai
bio: Kanai Ko is a Japanese director. Winner of 82nd Television Drama Academy Awards - Best Director for "Hero 2" (2014)

credits.title: The Gate of Murder
credits.overview: Kazuyuki Tajima strikes up a friendship with his elementary school classmate, Osamu Kuramochi. From that moment on, a dark shadow begins to fall over his life.
